question: The injured soldier let out a loud ________ of pain.
solution: Groan (V.) का अर्थ है दर्द या दुख में 'कराहना' (To make a deep sound of pain)।

question: The villagers had to ________ their homes due to the approaching storm.
solution: Flee (V.) का अर्थ है खतरे से 'भाग जाना' या बच निकलना (To escape from danger)।

question: Would you like to have tea ________ coffee with your breakfast?
solution: Or (Conj.) का अर्थ है 'अथवा' या या (Used to link alternatives)।

question: A strong wind ________ the fallen leaves across the empty street.
solution: Blew (V.) 'Blow' का भूतकाल है, जिसका अर्थ है हवा का 'बहना' (Moved as air current)।

question: The powerful king finally lost his ________ after the sudden rebellion.
solution: Throne (N.) का अर्थ यहाँ 'राजसत्ता' या अधिकार (Royal rule or sovereignty) है।

question: There has been a ________ increase in the temperature over the last few days.
solution: Gradual (Adj.) का अर्थ है 'क्रमिक' या धीरे-धीरे होने वाला (Happening slowly; step by step)।

question: The police uncovered an illegal ________ involving fake insurance claims.
solution: **Racket (N.)** का अर्थ यहाँ एक अवैध 'धोखाधड़ी' (A fraudulent scheme) है।

question: This red wine is the perfect ________ to the spicy Italian pasta.
solution: Complement (N.) का अर्थ है 'पूरक' जो किसी चीज़ को पूर्ण करे (Something that completes)।

question: The poem contains many ________ to the works of Shakespeare.
solution: Allusion (N.) का अर्थ है 'परोक्ष संदर्भ' या इशारा (An indirect reference)।

question: The quality of the construction was very ________ and unsafe.
solution: **Poor (Adj.)** का अर्थ यहाँ 'घटिया' या निम्न स्तर (Of low quality) का है।

question: After a heavy meal, I always look forward to a sweet ________.
solution: Dessert (N.) का अर्थ है भोजन के अंत में परोसी जाने वाली 'मिठाई'।

question: The male lion has a thick, impressive ________ around its neck.
solution: Mane (N.) का अर्थ है गर्दन के बाल या 'अयाल' (Long hair on the neck of a lion/horse)।

question: Please ________ your work properly and submit it by the deadline.
solution: Do (V.) का अर्थ है कोई कार्य 'करना' (To perform an action)।

question: Be careful while shopping; everything is quite ________ in this market.
solution: Dear (Adj.) का अर्थ यहाँ 'महँगा' (Expensive) है।

question: The rescue operation was carried out with great ________ and efficiency.
solution: Dispatch (N.) का अर्थ यहाँ 'तेजी' या तत्परता (Speed and efficiency) है।

question: The lion used its powerful ________s to pin down its prey.
solution: **Paws (N.)** का अर्थ है जानवर के 'पंजे' (Feet of an animal having claws)。

question: The movie was ________ interesting, although it was a bit too long.
solution: **Quite (Adv.)** का अर्थ है 'बिलकुल' या काफी हद तक (To a great extent)。

question: She is very ________ to start her new job as a graphic designer.
solution: Keen (Adj.) का अर्थ है किसी काम के लिए बहुत 'इच्छुक' या तत्पर (Eager or enthusiastic)।

question: I read a weekly ________ of the most important international news.
solution: Digest (N.) का अर्थ है सूचनाओं का 'संक्षेप' या सार (A summary of information)।

question: It takes a few hours for the stomach to fully ________ a heavy meal.
solution: Digest (V.) का अर्थ है भोजन 'पचाना' (To break down food in the body)।

question: The ________ of the military parade was impressive and well-organized.
solution: Tableau (N.) का अर्थ यहाँ एक व्यवस्थित 'क्रम या कतार' (A structured arrangement) है।

question: The giant's loud voice seemed to ________ across the entire valley.
solution: Bellow (V.) का अर्थ है ज़ोर से चिल्लाना या 'गरजना' (To shout in a loud voice)।

question: My birthday will ________ on a Saturday this year.
solution: Fall (V.) यहाँ 'घटित होना' (To happen at a particular time) के अर्थ में है।

question: Caviar is a luxury food item made from the processed ________ of sturgeon.
solution: Roe (N.) का अर्थ है 'मछली के अंडे' (The mass of eggs in a female fish)。

question: The heavy goods were ________ and ready to be transported by the truck.
solution: Baled (V.) का अर्थ है सामान को गट्ठर में 'लपेटना' या बांधना (Packed into bundles)।

question: Selling ________ drugs is a serious crime that can lead to imprisonment.
solution: Illicit (Adj.) का अर्थ है 'अवैध' या गैरकानूनी (Illegal or forbidden)।

question: Cow ________ is often dried and used as a source of fuel in villages.
solution: Dung (N.) का अर्थ है पशुओं का अपशिष्ट या 'गोबर' (Animal waste used as manure)।

question: Use a sharp peeler to ________ the skin off the potatoes.
solution: **Pare (V.)** का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को 'छीलना' या किनारे काटना (To trim or cut away)。

question: His constant criticism began to ________ her after a while.
solution: **Pique (V.)** का अर्थ है किसी को 'चिढ़ाना' या उत्तेजित करना (A feeling of annoyance)。

question: The climber slipped and grabbed onto a large ________ to save himself.
solution: Rock (N.) का अर्थ है एक बड़ी 'चट्टान' या पत्थर का टुकड़ा (A large piece of stone)。

question: You cannot ________ the past; you can only learn from it.
solution: Alter (V.) का अर्थ है 'बदलना' (To change)।

question: It takes a strong ________ power to overcome such difficult life challenges.
solution: Will (N.) का अर्थ यहाँ मानसिक 'इच्छा' शक्ति या संकल्प (Strong intention) है।

question: Walking ________foot on the hot sand was a painful experience.
solution: Bare (Adj.) का अर्थ है 'नंगा' या बिना ढका (Without covering or clothing)।

question: You should check the ________ of your luggage before heading to the airport.
solution: Weight (N.) का अर्थ है किसी वस्तु का 'वजन' या भार (A body's relative mass)。

question: The birds returned to their ________ as the sun began to set.
solution: Roost (N.) का अर्थ है पक्षियों का 'बसेरा' या आराम करने की जगह (A place where birds rest)。

question: Success is often the result of years of hard ________ and dedication.
solution: Toil (N.) का अर्थ है 'कठिन परिश्रम' (Hard work)。

question: The ________ is a large water bird known for its haunting call.
solution: Loon (N.) एक प्रकार का 'जल पक्षी' (A large water bird) है।

question: What ________ of fruits do you usually buy from the market?
solution: Kind (N.) का अर्थ है 'प्रकार' या श्रेणी (A sort or class of something)।

question: An ________ of everything, even good things, can be harmful.
solution: Excess (N.) का अर्थ है 'अतिरिक्त' या ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा (An amount more than necessary)।

question: Some philosophers believe that the divine is ________ in every living creature.
solution: Immanent (Adj.) का अर्थ है 'अन्तर्निहित' या जो अंदर ही व्याप्त हो (Inherent)।

question: You should ________ a heavy coat to protect yourself from the freezing cold.
solution: Wear (V.) का अर्थ है कपड़े या गहने 'पहनना' (To have clothes on the body)。

question: The general received an urgent ________ from the front lines.
solution: Dispatch (N.) का अर्थ यहाँ 'आधिकारिक संदेश' (An official message) है।

question: The ________ of his leather shoes was worn out after months of walking.
solution: Sole (N.) का अर्थ है जूते का 'तलवा' (The underside of a foot or shoe)。

question: The payment for the electricity bill is ________ by the 10th of this month.
solution: Due (Adj.) का अर्थ है 'बकाया' (Having to be paid)।

question: The stars look very bright on a clear and moonless ________.
solution: Night (N.) का अर्थ है 'रात' (The dark period after sunset)।

question: ________ law was declared in the region to restore peace and order.
solution: Martial (Adj.) का अर्थ यहाँ 'सैन्य' या युद्ध संबंधी (Related to war/military) है।

question: The explorers traveled across a vast ________ of unexplored jungle.
solution: Tract (N.) का अर्थ यहाँ ज़मीन का एक बड़ा 'क्षेत्र' (An expanse of land) है।

question: My grandfather often tells us a fascinating ________ about his youth.
solution: Tale (N.) का अर्थ है एक 'कहानी' या किस्सा (A story or narrative)。

question: He is the ________ owner of this massive business empire.
solution: Sole (Adj.) का अर्थ है 'एकमात्र' या केवल एक (Being the only one)。

question: Zayan finished in ________ place in the inter-school marathon.
solution: Tenth (Adj.) का अर्थ है 'दसवाँ' (Constituting number ten in a sequence)。

question: Our team managed to ________ the defending champions in the final match.
solution: Beat (V.) का अर्थ है किसी को खेल में 'पराजित करना' (To defeat someone)।

question: The cricket ________ was cancelled due to heavy rain and a wet outfield.
solution: Match (N.) का अर्थ यहाँ 'मुकाबला' या प्रतियोगिता (A competition) है।

question: The ________ forecast predicts heavy rain and thunderstorms for tomorrow.
solution: Weather (N.) का अर्थ है वायुमंडल की स्थिति या 'मौसम' (State of the atmosphere)。

question: Be careful not to ________ the important documents while opening the envelope.
solution: Tear (V.) का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को 'फाड़ना' (To pull apart by force)。

question: Please ________ some sugar to the tea.
solution: Add (V.) का अर्थ है 'जोड़ना' (To put something extra)।

question: There was a small ________ in my sock through which my toe was visible.
solution: Hole (N.) का अर्थ है 'छेद' या खोखली जगह (An opening or hollow space)।
